title: One observation of one generated asset, bound to its sha256 (final plan 5.4, OB-1; qa/observe.py); one JSON line of episodes/<ep>/qa/observations.jsonl

asset_id.description: the vault asset_id (imagegen/vault.py) when the asset has a record, else null

asset_path.description: path (relative to the episode folder, or absolute) the sha256 was taken from

questions.description: from the shot card's acceptance_questions, plus the observer's own

answers.description: question text or id -> the answer (bool, number or short text); an observer that measures writes its numbers here

where.description: frame, time range or word the defect is at, e.g. 't=2.60-4.00s' or 'word 3'

verdict.description: qa/status.py spelling; FAIL is read as BLOCK

action.description: R1 fix in place (trim, mute, reseed, inpaint), R2 prompt patch, R3 new keyframe or reference, R4 fallback 2.5D; from qa/retry_router.py

evidence.description: paths of the contact sheet, frame strip, transcript diff, task file

reviewed.description: {by: session|owner, at, note}: a person or the session looked at the evidence; an automatic observer's PASS counts only with this or an accepted calibration
